memory_update.text: Technology theme should be decomposed from AI/cloud demand into semiconductors, packaging, interconnect, optical materials, power/thermal infrastructure, and software control-plane beneficiaries before selecting securities.

HBM and advanced packaging overflow is a high-priority underfollowed discovery lane because AI memory demand may crowd out conventional backend capacity and benefit outsourced packaging/testing suppliers.

AI fabric interconnect is a distinct chokepoint lane between accelerators and networks, including retimers, CXL/PCIe connectivity, signal integrity, active cables, and hyperscaler-qualified merchant silicon.
Optical connectivity research should include lasers, silicon photonics, indium phosphide substrates, epitaxy, and epitaxy equipment, not only transceiver assemblers.
Data-center power and thermal infrastructure is a second-order AI beneficiary lane where old-economy electrical, cooling, and construction suppliers may be misclassified by the market.
AI security, observability, governance, and automation control-plane software is a less tangible but important software lane requiring careful evidence checks to avoid AI-washing.

Next layer must build a candidate universe with market cap, analyst coverage, revenue exposure, filing evidence, customer concentration, and falsification fields; this Layer 1A intentionally avoids buy/sell conclusions.

summary: Layer 1A decomposes the broad Technology theme into six researchable supply-chain nodes where demand from AI/cloud buildout, software automation, cybersecurity, and data-center infrastructure may create chokepoints outside the obvious mega-cap leaders. The strongest initial lanes are: advanced memory/packaging overflow, AI fabric interconnect, optical/compound-semiconductor tooling, indium phosphide substrates, data-center electrical/thermal infrastructure, and niche operational software/security for AI infrastructure. This is not a stock recommendation layer; it is a map for later evidence collection, candidate screening, and falsification.

supply_chain_nodes.market_cap_hunting_notes: Prioritize sub-USD 10B OSAT, test, substrate, and materials suppliers; allow larger Asian-listed suppliers if AI packaging exposure is unusually direct.

Separate pure HBM exposure from indirect overflow exposure.

supply_chain_nodes.bottleneck_hypothesis: Merchant suppliers of AI-specific connectivity, retimers, redrivers, CXL/PCIe components, active electrical cables, and switch-adjacent silicon may benefit as hyperscalers scale clusters faster than internal silicon teams can replace specialized suppliers.

theme_map.public_market_search_strategy: Use a two-lane funnel. Lane one maps reference leaders such as NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, TSMC, ASML, Arista, Vertiv, Eaton, hyperscalers, and major cloud/security software platforms to define where demand is real. Lane two hunts one or two steps upstream/downstream for public small- and mid-cap suppliers with narrow product exposure, customer concentration, qualification barriers, low analyst coverage, or obscure industry labels. Prioritize USD 300M-10B market-cap candidates where possible, include USD 10B-30B only when exposure is unusually pure, and label micro-caps as speculative shadow candidates. Later layers should verify revenue exposure, customer evidence, capex/qualification signals, backlog, margin inflection, balance-sheet risk, and whether the market has already priced the theme.
supply_side_constraints: HBM and advanced packaging capacity are structurally tight, with possible crowding-out effects into conventional DRAM/NAND backend packaging and testing.
AI fabric interconnect suppliers may be constrained by qualification cycles, hyperscaler customer concentration, and rapid product cadence.
Optical connectivity depends on lasers, compound semiconductor epitaxy, qualified wafers, and specialized epitaxy equipment.
Indium phosphide substrate supply appears highly concentrated among a few suppliers, making it a possible upstream chokepoint for optical components.
Data-center electrical and thermal infrastructure may be constrained by lead times, grid interconnection, transformer/switchgear availability, and skilled construction labor.

Cybersecurity and automation beneficiaries may be hidden in control-plane software, identity, compliance, observability, industrial OT security, and data governance rather than headline AI applications.
